card.text: Explore Toutatis with its published radar shape model.

introduction.text: Toutatis is an elongated, two-lobed near-Earth asteroid that tumbles as it travels around the Sun. Its radar-derived shape reveals a narrow neck, ridges and depressions. Chang’e-2 photographed one side during a 2012 flyby. Explore the published radar model here in a fixed illustrative orientation.

shape.title: Radar shape model
shape.summary: Shape from 1992 and 1996 radar data. Later images show differences; the gray grid marks missing imagery.
